description: Reopen r-sort-3b-memo (General) read-only. Reads (a.ID, b.ID) where a.ID < b.ID and a.MK = b.MK, and the same for TK; (MIN ID, MAX ID, COUNT) of GROUP BY MK and of GROUP BY TK; COUNT of DISTINCT MK and of DISTINCT TK; and the IDs of WHERE MK {=, >, <} each of the literals A x255, A x255 + x, A x256 + x and A x254 + B, and of MK LIKE A x255 followed by a star. Asks whether memo comparison, grouping, DISTINCT and LIKE use the whole value, a truncated prefix, or refuse, and which literal lengths the SQL parser admits.
retentionNote: Designed r-sort-3b probe (A-02); complete capture of the ACE answer.
